basics.name: Md Shamimur Rahman
basics.label: SE Researcher
basics.summary: A Bangladeshi-born Software Engineering researcher with a PhD in Computer Science, specializing in empirical software engineering, modern code review, and human-centered software development. My current research focuses on trustworthy AI-assisted software engineering, particularly the quality, understandability, and reviewability of AI-generated software.

education.studyType: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Computer Science
courses: Thesis: Beyond the Quality Gate: Understanding and Improving Developer Satisfaction for Sustainable Code Review
Supervisors: Prof. Chanchal K. Roy and Dr. Zadia Codabux
education.summary: Investigated modern code review as a socio-technical process, focusing on developer satisfaction, code comprehension, and collaboration. Through empirical studies and data-driven approaches, the research examined reviewer selection, file ordering, review comment clarity, incivility, and pull request stalling. The findings offer practical insights and recommendations for improving code review effectiveness and developer experience.

education.studyType: Master of Science (MSc) in Computer Science
courses: Thesis: Aspect of Code Cloning Towards Software Bug and Imminent Maintenance: A Perspective on Open-source and Industrial Mobile Applications
education.summary: Investigated code cloning in open-source and industrial mobile applications, focusing on its relationship with software bugs and maintenance activities. The research examined clone-related characteristics and their implications for software quality and maintenance, providing empirical insights into the role of code clones in software evolution.

interests.name: Empirical Software Engineering
interests.summary: Applying repository mining, developer studies, and data-driven methods to understand software development practices, identify challenges, and develop empirically grounded improvements.

interests.name: Human-Centered Software Engineering
interests.summary: Investigating developer satisfaction, communication, collaboration, cognitive workload, psychological safety, and sustainable participation in software development.

interests.name: Modern Code Review and Software Quality
interests.summary: Improving code review effectiveness through better reviewer assignment, code comprehension, review feedback, and coordination while supporting software quality and developer experience.

interests.name: Trustworthy and Accountable AI for Software Engineering
interests.summary: Developing methods to make AI-generated software reviewable, verifiable, reliable, and accountable through independent assurance, risk-sensitive validation, and human oversight.

interests.name: AI-Generated Code Review and Comprehension
interests.summary: Designing context-aware review assistants that identify relevant dependencies, unchanged files, and repository history to help reviewers understand and validate AI-generated changes.

interests.name: Human-AI Collaboration in Software Development
interests.summary: Examining how AI coding agents reshape reviewer workload, human judgment, mentoring, knowledge transfer, expertise development, and long-term team sustainability.
